description: Generate items from a managed loot table and context.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Loot Table, and handle Flow or Failed.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Provides the player context for loot generation.

inputs.name: entity
inputs.description: Provides the entity context for loot generation.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: Provides the location context for loot generation.

inputs.name: loot_table
inputs.description: Selects the managed loot table to generate.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the typed loot operation result.

description: Generate loot and give every resulting item to a player.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Loot Table and Player, then handle Flow or Failed.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player who receives the loot.

inputs.name: loot_table
inputs.description: Selects the managed loot table to generate.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when loot is given successfully.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when loot cannot be given.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the typed loot operation result.

description: Generate loot and add every resulting item to a container.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a Loot Table and Location, then handle Flow or Failed.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Provides the player context for loot generation.

inputs.name: entity
inputs.description: Provides the entity context for loot generation.

inputs.name: loot_table
inputs.description: Selects the managed loot table to generate.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the container is filled successfully.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the container cannot be filled.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the typed loot operation result.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the container was filled.

description: Apply a managed Trade Profile to a villager.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a villager and Trade Profile, then handle Flow or Failed.

inputs.name: entity
inputs.description: Provides the villager that receives the profile.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the profile is applied.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the profile cannot be applied.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the typed trade operation result.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the profile was applied.

description: Open a managed Trade Profile for a player and villager.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a Player, Entity, and Trade Profile, then handle Flow or Failed.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player who sees the trades.

inputs.name: entity
inputs.description: Provides the villager whose trades open.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the typed trade operation result.

description: Open a managed Trade Profile for a player with an optional entity context.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a Player and Trade Profile, then handle Flow or Failed.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player who sees the trades.

inputs.name: entity
inputs.description: Provides optional entity context for the trades.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when virtual trades cannot open.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the typed trade operation result.

description: Spawn a managed NPC at a selected location.
examples: Connect Flow, select an NPC Definition and Location, then handle Flow or Failed.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: Selects where the NPC should spawn.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the NPC cannot spawn.

outputs.name: entity
outputs.description: Returns the backing entity when one is available.

examples: Connect Flow, select an NPC Definition, and handle Flow or Failed.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the NPC cannot despawn.

description: Open a managed NPC interface for a player.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a Player and NPC Definition, then handle Flow or Failed.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player who sees the interface.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the NPC interface opens.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the NPC interface cannot open.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the NPC interface opened.

description: Set the Trade Profile used by a managed NPC.
examples: Connect Flow, select an NPC and Trade Profile, then handle Flow or Failed.

inputs.name: profile_id
inputs.description: Selects the Trade Profile to assign.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues when the NPC profile changes.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the NPC profile cannot change.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the NPC profile changed.

description: Resolve the active handle for a managed NPC.
examples: Select an NPC Definition and connect Handle or Result to a compatible input.

outputs.name: handle
outputs.description: Returns the active NPC handle when available.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether an active NPC was found.

description: List handles for all active managed NPCs.
examples: Connect Handles or Result to a compatible list input.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the typed active NPC list result.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the active NPC list was read.

description: Check whether a managed NPC is active.
examples: Select an NPC Definition and use Active or Handle in the next node.

outputs.name: active
outputs.description: Reports whether the NPC is active.

outputs.name: handle
outputs.description: Returns the active NPC handle when available.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the active-state check completed.

description: Read the current location of an active managed NPC.
examples: Provide an NPC Handle and connect Location or Result to a compatible input.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the NPC location was read.

description: Read the backing entity for an active managed NPC.
examples: Provide an NPC Handle and connect Entity or Available to a compatible input.

outputs.name: entity
outputs.description: Returns the backing entity when one is available.

outputs.name: available
outputs.description: Reports whether a backing entity is available.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns the typed entity availability result.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Reports whether the entity check completed.

description: Teleport an active managed NPC to a selected location.
examples: Connect Flow, provide an NPC Handle and Location, then handle Flow or Failed.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: Continues when the NPC cannot teleport.

description: Run when a player interacts with a managed NPC.
examples: Connect Flow to the actions that should run after NPC interaction.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Starts the connected flow for the interaction.

outputs.name: event.entity
outputs.description: Returns the backing NPC entity when available.

outputs.name: event.left_click
outputs.description: Reports whether the interaction was a left click.

outputs.name: event.right_click
outputs.description: Reports whether the interaction was a right click.

outputs.name: event.shifting
outputs.description: Reports whether the player was shifting.

outputs.name: event.packet_backed
outputs.description: Reports whether the NPC is packet backed.

outputs.name: event.cancelled
outputs.description: Reports whether the interaction was cancelled.
